headword: {先端技術|せんたんぎじゅつ}

definitions.gloss: cutting-edge technology; advanced technology; high technology
definitions.explanation: The most advanced or innovative technology available in a given field. Refers to technology at the forefront of development.

examples.japanese: {先端技術|せんたんぎじゅつ}を{開発|かいはつ}する。
この{分野|ぶんや}の{先端技術|せんたんぎじゅつ}は{日|ひ}々{進歩|しんぽ}している。
examples.english: The cutting-edge technology in this field is advancing day by day.

examples.japanese: {先端技術|せんたんぎじゅつ}を{活用|かつよう}して{社会|しゃかい}{問題|もんだい}の{解決|かいけつ}に{取|と}り{組|く}んでいる。
examples.english: We are working on solving social problems by utilizing advanced technology.

notes:
Composed of {先端|せんたん} (tip, forefront) + {技術|ぎじゅつ} (technology, technique). Widely used in news, business, and academic contexts to describe the latest technological innovations.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {先端技術|せんたんぎじゅつ}を{開発|かいはつ}する: to develop advanced technology
- {先端技術|せんたんぎじゅつ}を{活用|かつよう}する: to utilize cutting-edge technology
- {先端技術|せんたんぎじゅつ}{分野|ぶんや}: the field of advanced technology
- {先端技術|せんたんぎじゅつ}{企業|きぎょう}: high-tech company

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {最先端|さいせんたん}{技術|ぎじゅつ}: the very latest technology — slightly stronger emphasis on being the absolute forefront
- ハイテク: high-tech — a casual loanword abbreviation
- {科学技術|かがくぎじゅつ}: science and technology — broader term encompassing both science and technology
- {情報技術|じょうほうぎじゅつ}: information technology (IT) — specifically about computing and data
